systems.country_label: reseaux de fibre optique deployes pour la SIN

note: Decree of 2020-12-23 is a dig-once rule (contractors lay fibre owned by SIN), a transfer of unlicensed networks to SIN and a duty on SIN to give licensed operators access to what it operates; it states no backbone built, in service or reaching regions, and names no inter-regional backbone, so no reach or access fact is recorded.
